lines.text: It’s project time! Design an interactive show for an audience — a story, quiz or music performance (or all three) — with at least two scenes started by messages, a loop, a variable, and ways for the audience to take part.
Make an interactive show for an audience: a story with a quiz, a music video with a dance, a nature show with questions — you choose!
Your show should use: events to start and interact, a loop, a variable (like a score or counter), messages to change scenes, and either a question (ask) or keys/clicks to play.
Write a running order: scene 1, scene 2, scene 3.
For each, list the sprites, the backdrop and what the audience does.
At the end, present your show: play it, explain one clever piece of code, and say what you would add next.
Great work! Let’s remember what we learned.
Now plan it, build it, test it, and share it!
